messages.subject: Serial mediation sytax
parts:
Hello,

I would be very grateful if someone could help my with my syntax for serial mediation. The hypothesis is: X -> M1 -> M1 -> Y.

Y ~ c*X + b1*M1 + b2*M2
M1 ~ a1*X
M2 ~ a2*X + b3*M1

I'd like to calculate the total indirect effect, would that be:
indtotal := (a1*b1) + (a2*b2) + (a1*b2*b3)

Thanks in advance!
Nika

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: Serial mediation sytax
parts:
That looks right. (Except you have made a typo in the description of the hypothesis).

What do the results look like? Do you have reason to doubt them? (It can depend on which function you use as they have different defaults.)

Jeremy
